crossRefs.note: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
The Lord has become as an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed his…
He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden. He has destroyed his place of assembly. Yahweh…
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
where then is my hope? as for my hope, who will see it?
The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be…
I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

translations.web: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
translations.bsb: He tears me down on every side until I am gone; He uproots my hope like a tree.
translations.kjv: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
translations.asv: He hath broken me down on every side, and I am gone; And my hope hath he plucked up like a tree.
